_comment: Renderer registry for bridge.py: request "model" id -> workflow template (path relative to this file), weight stack ('qwen' | 'flux', selects the preset block in presets.json and whether a switch unloads the other stack), display label (llmctl). Optional per renderer: "lora_node" = id of a LoraLoaderModelOnly node in that workflow whose strength the request field lora_strength sets. Optional top level: "extra_lora" = {"file": <models/loras/ file>, "stacks": [...]}, spliced in when a request sets lora2. A box-local registry at comfyui/local/renderers.json (git-ignored, mounted at /opt/bridge-local) replaces this file entirely.
